scenarios.title: A kicked spell applies its kicker-linked effect, an unkicked one does not
decisions: A casts Burst Lightning paying its kicker {4} (total {4}{R}, tapping all five Mountains), targeting Centaur Courser.
Both players pass; the spell resolves.

variants.label: kicked
variants.expected: Burst Lightning was kicked and deals 4 damage to Centaur Courser (3/3), which is destroyed and is in B's graveyard.

variants.label: unkicked
variants.delta: A does not pay the kicker; A casts Burst Lightning for {R} only.
variants.expected: Burst Lightning deals 2 damage to Centaur Courser, which stays on the battlefield with 2 damage marked.

scenarios.title: Multikicker counts how many times the cost was paid
decisions: A casts Everflowing Chalice paying its multikicker {2} twice (tapping all four Mountains).
Both players pass; the spell resolves.

variants.label: kicked_twice
variants.expected: Everflowing Chalice enters the battlefield with 2 charge counters.

variants.label: kicked_once
variants.delta: A pays the multikicker only once (two Mountains tapped).
variants.expected: Everflowing Chalice enters with 1 charge counter.

variants.label: unkicked
variants.expected: Everflowing Chalice enters with no charge counters.

scenarios.title: A kicker-linked triggered ability fires only if its object was kicked
decisions: A casts Gatekeeper of Malakir paying its kicker {B} (total {B}{B}{B}, tapping three Swamps).
Both players pass; the spell resolves and the enters trigger goes on the stack targeting player B.
Both players pass; the trigger resolves.

variants.label: kicked
variants.expected: The 'if it was kicked' trigger fires: B sacrifices Grizzly Bears (B's only creature), which is in B's graveyard. Gatekeeper of Malakir is on the battlefield.

variants.label: unkicked
variants.delta: A casts Gatekeeper of Malakir for {B}{B} only, without the kicker.
variants.expected: No trigger fires. Grizzly Bears stays on B's battlefield and Gatekeeper of Malakir is on the battlefield.

scenarios.title: Each 'kicked with its' ability applies only if the matching kicker cost was paid
decisions: A casts Thornscape Battlemage paying its {R} kicker (total {2}{G}{R}, tapping Forest, Forest, Forest and Mountain).
Both players pass; the spell resolves and the enters trigger goes on the stack targeting player B.
Both players pass; the trigger resolves.

variants.label: kicked_red
variants.expected: The 'kicked with its {R} kicker' trigger fires: it deals 2 damage to B (life 20 to 18). Phyrexian Walker is not affected.

variants.label: kicked_white
variants.delta: A pays the {W} kicker instead of the {R} kicker (tapping Plains instead of Mountain), and the trigger targets Phyrexian Walker.
variants.expected: The 'kicked with its {W} kicker' trigger fires: Phyrexian Walker (an artifact creature) is destroyed and is in B's graveyard. B's life stays 20.

variants.label: unkicked
variants.expected: Neither trigger fires: B's life stays 20 and Phyrexian Walker stays on the battlefield.

scenarios.title: A kicker-conditional target is chosen only if the spell is kicked

setup.notes: Grizzly Bears is the only creature on the battlefield.

decisions: A tries to cast Jilt targeting Grizzly Bears, paying {1}{U} (and the kicker {1}{R} when kicked).

variants.label: unkicked
variants.expected: The cast is legal (can_play true) with a single target: the damage part of Jilt is not part of the spell when it is unkicked, so no second target is needed.

variants.label: kicked
variants.delta: A also pays the kicker {1}{R}, tapping all four lands.
variants.expected: The cast is illegal (can_play false): a kicked Jilt needs another target creature to deal 2 damage to, and Grizzly Bears is the only creature.
